stylesheets: Only what the frame and the Changelog use: 6 of autolaunch.sh's 48 stylesheets, cut to the rules those use. Each file is wrapped in @scope (:root[data-product="autolaunch"]:has(.shell)) to (.regents-frame): it stops at regents.sh's frame, and :has(.shell) keeps it off the /autolaunch overview, which is regents.sh's own page; html reads :scope. autolaunch.sh sets no product on its page, so its main button, link, focus and chosen colours are restated per theme from Regent UI 69dbfface, so they win over Regent UI's Autolaunch product colours. Its plain links and focus ring are restated at the weight of regents.sh's own rules, which they meet unscoped.

About, How it works and Docs: each reads the deployment file through Autolaunch.Lab.current!/0; Docs also reads the tool manifest's features, CoveredCalls.Deployment.current/0 and Autolaunch.OAuth.enabled?/0.
The motion lab (/animations): autolaunch.sh shows it only with AUTOLAUNCH_SHOWCASE on (it answers 404 there today), and regents.sh has its own.

The market ticker (MarketTickerLive), the $REGENT menu (RegentFacts.pool/0), search (SearchLive) and the header's agents and account menu with Pair New Agent: each reads what is not here yet; left out whole, not disabled.
The rail with its Launch button: its links are the bar's; the pages it names come with their slices.
Autolaunch's Live.Session, page shell plug, theme script and theme plug: this site's session, root document and theme switch (the same regent_theme cookie) serve every page.
